mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals economic weakness and potential corporate earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the market faces an inflationary policy dilemma, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which signals potential economic contraction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of weak housing demand (HOUST < 900) and declining industrial output (INDPRO < 98.0), the economy faces a dual slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recoveries, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of early-cycle recovery periods when INDPRO > 100.
